The approximate per-liter Difco table lists pancreatic digest of casein10g, Proteose Peptone No.3 5g, yeast extract5g, beef heart infusion from500g 3g, corn starch1g, sodium chloride5g and agar15g; the footnote allows adjustment/supplementation to meet performance criteria. It directs suspension of44g powder in1L purified water. Those are manufacturer preparation/formula statements, not dry-product mass fractions, final yield, or an identified historical JCM lot. The same page separately gives BBL42.5g (including13.5g agar, meat peptic digest and heart pancreatic digest) and DifcoEH39g (including12g agar and different nutrient inputs). The older mirrored manual has different heart wording and BBL proportions and is retained as separate version context. The old search wrapper and failed official/mirror requests remain historical leads, not primary manual evidence.
